problem_statement: Abhay557/Discord-Bot-Website is a static Discord bot website (plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step) rebranded here as Thornbeak, a fictional moderation and utility bot. The dark landing page has an Invite CTA, a Bot Setup Flow chip strip, three feature cards, a services counter row, a footer, and a responsive hamburger nav overlay. A separate Commands page exposes a command-category column, a live search box, a Command Starter Flow chip strip, and Bootstrap accordions for the bot's nine slash commands. The catalog's native browse control is the Command Explorer: a category filter strip (All Commands / Moderation / General / Leveling / Premium) above the command list that filters the visible command sections and reports a live count in the form 'Showing N of 9 · <Category>'. The same Command Explorer is surfaced as a compact teaser on the landing page (title + 'Browse 9 commands' + an Open catalog link) so the hero links into the catalog. Clicking a Command Explorer chip must re-filter the command sections AND update the readout count; the strip must wrap inside a 390px phone viewport with no horizontal overflow; the Command Explorer must appear on both the landing page and the Commands page; and the chips must stay legible and non-overlapping. Implement the Command Explorer in the existing static structure via css/explorer.css (layout/legibility/responsive) and js/explorer.js (which surfaces and wires the strip), preserving the dark Discord-bot visual system, the setup/starter flow chips, the command categories, search, accordions, mobile nav, and the desktop layout.
required_content: The Command Explorer filter strip on Commands.html renders its chips (All Commands / Moderation / General / Leveling / Premium) and a live 'Showing N of 9 · <Category>' readout above the command list, inside the viewport with no horizontal overflow on the 390px mobile_commands state.

The Command Explorer is surfaced on BOTH the landing page (a compact teaser with the Command Explorer title, a Browse count, and an Open catalog link) and the Commands page (the full filter strip), using real rendered DOM text.
Clicking a Command Explorer chip filters the command sections to that category AND updates the readout to the matching count (e.g. clicking Moderation shows 'Showing 3 of 9 · Moderation').

The landing page keeps the Thornbeak hero, Features and Invite buttons, Bot Setup Flow chips, feature cards, services counters, footer links, and mobile hamburger nav overlay; the Commands page keeps the category column, search box, Command Starter Flow chips, and command accordions.

Visible rendered DOM text still includes Bot Setup Flow, Command Starter Flow, Command Explorer, Invite Bot, Pick Commands, Test /help, Search /help, Open /invite, and Ready for Server across the completion states.

The fix is implemented in the existing static HTML/CSS/JS structure (css/explorer.css and js/explorer.js) with no new dependencies, remote APIs, iframes, or template replacement, and every state runs console- and network-clean.
design_constraints: Preserve the dark Discord-bot identity: compact top nav, blue/teal accent CTA colors, Roboto typography, small-radius buttons, dark card surfaces, and local illustration assets.
Keep the Command Explorer as a chip strip that matches the existing setup-flow and starter-flow chip rhythm; do not replace it with a dropdown, modal, dashboard, or unrelated wizard.
Make the Command Explorer a genuine category filter: chip clicks must re-filter the command sections and recompute the visible-command count, not merely toggle an active style.

The mobile layout must keep the strip inside the phone viewport (no horizontal overflow, tolerance 24px) by wrapping the chip row, rather than clipping content with overflow-x while a fixed-width row still exceeds the viewport.
Keep the Command Explorer chips legible and non-overlapping on desktop; do not shingle them with negative margins or render dark-on-dark text.

Keep index.html and Commands.html as static pages served by the existing file layout; preserve the command category buttons, search input, accordion behavior, bootstrap script, mobile nav toggle, feature cards, service counters, and footer links.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the Thornbeak landing hero, Invite CTA, illustration, Bot Setup Flow chips, the Command Explorer teaser, and the responsive shell.
desktop_features and desktop_services protect the original lower landing sections.

desktop_commands protects the Commands page category column, search box, Command Starter Flow chips, the Command Explorer strip with its 'Showing 9 of 9 · All Commands' readout, and the command accordions.
desktop_commands_explorer is the interaction discriminator: clicking the Moderation chip filters the sections to Moderation AND updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 9 · Moderation'.
desktop_commands_search_help verifies the search still narrows the list around /help.
desktop_command_invite_open verifies the /invite accordion still opens and shows Usage Examples.

mobile_commands is the overflow discriminator: at 390px the reference Command Explorer strip wraps and stays inside the viewport (no horizontal overflow), while fixed-width non-wrapping variants overflow horizontally.
mobile_nav_open protects the narrow-screen hamburger nav overlay behavior.

change_completion: The Command Explorer chip strip and its 'Showing N of 9 · <Category>' readout render on the Commands page inside the 390px viewport with no horizontal overflow on mobile_commands.
The Command Explorer is surfaced on both the landing page and the Commands page.
Clicking a Command Explorer chip re-filters the command sections and updates the readout to the selected category count.
The landing-page Bot Setup Flow chips and Commands-page Command Starter Flow chips remain visible; the fix is a static-site change with no live Discord APIs or hidden-only strings.
design_consistency: The Command Explorer strip matches the existing dark surface, blue/teal accent, small-radius chip, and compact spacing, and stays legible (no dark-on-dark, no overlapping chips).
The extension stays subordinate to the command list instead of introducing a heavy new section.
Mobile layout wraps chip labels cleanly while keeping the hamburger menu, hero copy, and command controls usable.
regression: Landing hero, illustration, Features/Invite buttons, feature cards, service counters, footer links, and mobile nav overlay remain visible.
Commands page category filters, search box, /help and /invite entries, and accordion behavior remain present.
The static server run path and local CSS/JS/image assets continue to work without package installation.
responsive: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the landing shell across viewports.
desktop_commands, desktop_commands_explorer, desktop_commands_search_help, desktop_command_invite_open, and mobile_commands protect the command discovery flow and interactions.
mobile_commands must have no horizontal overflow after the Command Explorer wraps.

author_notes: Product-grade L4 hardening of slot_172 on the same ledger repo (Abhay557/Discord-Bot-Website rebranded Thornbeak). The native lever is the Command Explorer, the chat/bot genre's own command-catalog category filter: a chip strip (All Commands / Moderation / General / Leveling / Premium) above the command accordions on Commands.html with a live 'Showing N of 9 · Category' readout, reusing the repo's own command taxonomy, plus a compact Command Explorer teaser on the landing page. The static Discord bot website is served directly (real 404) and is already fully vendored with local CSS, JS, SVG and PNG image assets, so all eleven states run console- and network-clean. HTML is byte-identical across the reference/baseline/bad legs; only css/explorer.css (layout + responsive + legibility) and js/explorer.js (surface whitelist + readout wiring) vary. Four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow on mobile_commands (reference wraps to 0, fixed non-wrapping rows overflow), cross-page dom_assertions for the Command Explorer teaser on the landing page, visual_regression on the desktop command states (bad shingles its chips into an illegible dark-on-dark pile), and interaction_assertions for the Moderation-chip readout.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Static Discord bot website (Abhay557/Discord-Bot-Website) rebranded to Thornbeak; the extend_interaction task builds the genre-native Command Explorer command-catalog filter (category chips + live 'Showing N of 9' count) over the bot's real command accordions, exercising four orthogonal gates (mobile overflow, cross-page presence, visual regression, and filter interaction) while preserving the dark bot visual system, command search, accordions, and mobile nav.
metadata.design_goal: extend the local visual system through typography, spacing, component rhythm, and responsive layout
